subject: Request: BlueHorizon Health demo — gating items & potential reschedule
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@bluehorizonhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo logistics and gating items for BlueHorizon

Hi Evan — great to connect yesterday.

Per our conversation, we can run a 45–60 minute product walkthrough focused on using Redwood Inference for clinical summarization and cost-sensitive inference. Before we lock the full technical deep-dive, procurement/security at BlueHorizon will need the usual onboarding items completed so the demo team can access the vendor portal and SSO test accounts.

To keep things moving, proposed next steps:
- Quick exec overview (30m) to get the C-suite aligned (we can do this without portal access).
- Full technical demo after vendor portal and questionnaire are complete (we typically do this when IdP test accounts are available).

Required gating items from your side:
1) NDA signed (we can send DocuSign)
2) Vendor portal onboarding — we send an invite and your security team completes the intake
3) Security questionnaire (we'll attach a short spreadsheet)
4) IdP/SSO test user creation for a one-hour session

Irene is copied on this thread to coordinate the questionnaire & SSO steps. I can send a DocuSign NDA now if you want us to.

If travel or exec schedules are tight, we can do an executive-only 30-minute overview first and then schedule the technical session after gating completes. Proposed windows: July 7–9 (morning PT) for exec overview, July 12–16 for technical deep-dive (tentative).

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@bluehorizonhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + demo logistics and gating items for BlueHorizon

Jordan — thanks for the clear breakdown. Two quick things: 1) Our CMO (Dr. Karen Holt) is traveling July 7–10 and will not be available for an exec walkthrough that week, 2) our procurement team has requested we complete the vendor portal onboarding and SSO proof-of-identity before any technical access is granted.

Procurement says they can complete the portal onboarding by the end of next week (they start intake today) but asked if we could delay the full technical demo until the portal and SSO are done. They also asked if an executive overview could be held the week of July 5–9 but would prefer July 12 if the CMO is required.

If your team is flexible, we'd prefer a short 30-minute exec overview for the executive team the week of July 12 when the CMO is back and procurement has completed the intake. Alternatively, if you can run an exec-only 20–30 minute session for the product leadership without the CMO the week of July 7, we can do that as an interim step.

Also, could you send the DocuSign NDA and the security questionnaire so procurement can start the intake? Attaching our internal POI for SSO (one-page) that the IdP team requested.

Attachment: POI-BlueHorizon-SSO.pdf (application/pdf)

—Evan

Thanks Evan — and thanks for the POI, received.

Quick alignment from our side: we can absolutely be flexible. Two pragmatic options so procurement doesn't become a blocker:

Option A — Exec overview only (recommended if CMO unavailable): a 25–30 minute executive briefing that covers outcomes, ROI signals, and a high-level architecture. No vendor portal or IdP required. Good for July 7–9 if leadership can meet without Dr. Holt.

Option B — Wait for full tech session: schedule the 60-minute technical walkthrough after portal onboarding and SSO test accounts are in place (July 12–16 sounds reasonable if procurement completes the intake by July 6).

To unblock procurement, I'm attaching the short security questionnaire (redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx) and I'll trigger the DocuSign NDA link for your team now. Marcus, can you confirm we have the correct HubSpot record so I can include the procurement contact in the portal invite?

Action items:
- Irene: send DocuSign link + questionnaire (attached).
- Evan/procurement: complete portal intake and create an IdP test user (names + email) by July 6 if possible.
- Jordan/Marcus: hold proposed windows and coordinate calendar invites once Evan confirms which option they prefer.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
